title: mini-grandmaster-rollout-conductor-with-replay-backed-undo
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce human toil and time-to-rollback for multi-cohort hybrid canaries and A/B experiments by introducing a lightweight conductor process (the 'mini-grandmaster') that coordinates short-lived snapshots, deterministic replay for undo, and automated rollback autopilot hooks. This PR implements the orchestration loop, snapshot metadata ledger, a retention/TTL policy, and an operator-facing CLI to trigger dry-run, replay, and prune operations. Design highlights: 1) Timebound snapshots tied to traffic-phase IDs to minimize storage; 2) Deterministic replay path that replays sampled requests against previous model revision in isolation for fast verification; 3) Autopilot rollback policy that can auto-trigger on safety gates (latency regression, error spike) and optionally run replay-backed confirmation before full revert; 4) Small API extension for rollout controllers to declare snapshot hints and required replay fidelity. Compatibility notes: backward-compatible with existing rollout graph, new feature toggled via rollout.spec.grandmaster.enabled. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4123) [x] operator CLI and docs [x] unit/integration tests for replay harness [x] e2e dry-run in benchmark-lab with synthetic cohorts [x] CI stable on rerun. Impact: enables faster, auditable rollbacks for multi-cohort promotions without introducing long-lived heavy controllers.
commits: feat(conductor): add mini-grandmaster orchestration loop and snapshot ledger
feat(operator): add CLI subcommands grandmaster dry-run|replay|prune
chore(tests): deterministic replay harness and seeded integration tests
docs(rollouts): operator README and runbook for snapshot retention
fix(ci): increase test timeouts and stabilize canary-sim flaky cases
release_notes: Introduce mini-grandmaster rollout conductor: coordinated timebound snapshots, deterministic replay for rollback verification, operator CLI for dry-run/replay/prune, and autopilot rollback policy. Backwards compatible behind feature flag.
